title: IVG Original Salts Vanilla Biscuit 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Original Salts Vanilla Biscuit 10ml E-Liquid offers a warm and indulgent vaping experience, perfectly suited for those who prefer dessert profiles over fruit. This blend recreates the familiar taste of golden, baked Biscuits, providing a rich and buttery base. A smooth, velvety layer of Vanilla Custard filling flows throughout the flavour, adding depth and a rounded sweetness that makes for an exceptionally satisfying, comforting vape. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal balance of discreet vapour production and clear, intense flavour. IVG Original Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The IVG Original Salts collection is inspired by the brand’s most successful flavour profiles, offering vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and dessert blends. Beyond the comforting Vanilla Biscuit, vapers can explore other stellar options like the vibrant Blue Blaze or the complex Forest Berries Ice. Every e-liquid in this collection is designed to provide a high-quality, authentic experience for mouth-to-lung vapers.
